query: How do I make mango sorbet?

goal.title: Prepare and store a blended mango mixture
goal.description: Peel and cut a mango, blend its flesh with lemon juice and sugar, scrape the mixture into a covered storage box and place it in the freezer. Reopen the box and stir it with a spoon.
goal.final_state: A coarse yellow mango mixture sits in an uncovered box at the open freezer. The green lid and spoon remain held; successful freezing, serving and eating are not shown.

procedure.description: Hold the whole unpeeled mango and take a knife. Make repeated cutting attempts while rotating the fruit, but no cheek separates. Put down the knife, pick at the surface sticker, move to the utensil drawer and retrieve a black Y-shaped peeler before returning to the board.

Peel successive sides of the mango with repeated downward strokes, turning it in the left hand between strokes. Skin strips accumulate on the cutting board. Put the peeler down when most of the yellow flesh is exposed.

Take the knife and slice alongside the pit to separate broad cheeks and smaller side strips. Rotate and reposition the remaining fruit for further cuts. Set the exposed flattened pit to the left, then cut the flesh into chunks and lower the knife onto the board.
Lift several handfuls of chopped mango into the open blender jug. Adjust the jug on its base, briefly turn the black central blade shaft, and continue picking up and dropping the remaining chunks.

Take the green lemon juice bottle, unscrew its cap and pour liquid into the mango-filled jug. Replace the cap and set the bottle down. Take the clear sugar shaker, pour white granules into the jug, set the shaker down and fit the black lid.

Hold the lid with the left hand and operate the blender buttons with the right. Stop and lift the lid, take the blue spatula and scrape mixture from the jug walls. Replace the lid and run the blender again. Remove the lid, pull out the central blade assembly and lay it on the cutting board.

Lift the jug by its handle, tilt it over a clear rectangular storage box and scrape the coarse yellow mixture into the box using the spatula. Return the nearly empty jug to its base and spread the mixture inside the box.

Pick up the green lid and lift the box. Carry it to the freezer and pull the door open while keeping the spatula. Set the box at the opening, smooth the mixture further, press the lid on and place the covered box on an upper shelf. Shift another food package to make room, withdraw and close the door.

Carry the spatula to the dish rack and put it down. Open the utensil drawer and fetch a spoon. Return directly to the freezer, reopen it, bring the box to the opening and remove its green lid. Stir and scrape the mixture with the spoon while holding the lid in the other hand. Finish paused beside the uncovered box; no serving or visibly frozen result is shown.

coarse.instruction: Prepare the mango and retrieve a peeler
coarse.description: Take the knife, attempt cuts through the unpeeled mango, put the knife down and pick at its sticker. Carry the mango to an utensil drawer, open it, retrieve a peeler and return to the cutting board.
coarse.goal_contribution: Obtains a peeling tool after initial cutting attempts leave the whole mango intact.

coarse.description: Hold and repeatedly rotate the mango in the left hand while scraping its skin with the right-hand peeler. Remove skin from successive sides and put the peeler on the board.
coarse.goal_contribution: Exposes mango flesh before cutting pieces for blending.
coarse.predictability_reason: The retrieved peeler naturally leads to peeling the mango.

coarse.instruction: Cut mango flesh away from the pit
coarse.description: Take the knife, slice cheeks and narrow strips from the peeled mango, turn the fruit between cuts, set the exposed pit aside and chop the flesh into smaller pieces.
coarse.goal_contribution: Separates edible mango flesh from the pit and makes chunks that can be loaded into the blender.
coarse.predictability_reason: The peeled mango must be cut to obtain flesh for blending.

coarse.instruction: Load mango chunks into the blender
coarse.description: Gather successive handfuls of mango and drop them into the jug. Adjust the jug on its base, turn its central blade assembly, then add the remaining pieces.
coarse.goal_contribution: Places the prepared fruit in the blender and adjusts the components before operating it.
coarse.predictability_reason: The cut mango chunks are ready to load into the blender.

coarse.description: Pick up and uncap the green lemon juice bottle, pour liquid over the fruit, recap and set it down. Take the sugar shaker, pour white granules into the jug and fit the blender lid.
coarse.goal_contribution: Combines the fruit with the visible added ingredients and covers the jug for blending.
coarse.predictability_reason: With mango in the blender, adding flavorings is plausible, though blending could begin directly.

coarse.instruction: Blend and scrape the mango mixture
coarse.description: Operate the blender while holding its lid. Lift the lid, take a spatula and scrape the jug walls, replace the lid and blend again. Remove the lid and central blade assembly and set the assembly on the board.
coarse.goal_contribution: Breaks the mango into a coarse yellow mixture and removes the blade assembly for transfer.
coarse.predictability_reason: The loaded and seasoned blender is ready to blend the mixture.

coarse.instruction: Transfer mango mixture to the storage container
coarse.description: Lift and tilt the jug over the rectangular container, scrape its contents out with the spatula, return the emptied jug to its base and spread the transferred mixture in the box.
coarse.goal_contribution: Collects and levels the blended mixture in a container suitable for freezer storage.
coarse.predictability_reason: The blended mixture must be transferred for storage.

coarse.instruction: Cover and place the mixture in the freezer
coarse.description: Lift the container and green lid, carry them to the freezer and open its door while retaining the spatula. Set the box at the opening, smooth the mixture again, press on the lid, place the box on an upper shelf, rearrange a food package and close the door.
coarse.goal_contribution: Covers the prepared mixture and briefly puts it inside the freezer; a frozen result is not established.
coarse.predictability_reason: A container of mango mixture is ready to cover and freeze.

coarse.instruction: Fetch a spoon and stir the stored mango mixture
coarse.description: Carry the spatula to the dish rack and release it. Open the utensil drawer, retrieve a spoon, return to the freezer and open it. Bring the container forward, remove its green lid, stir and scrape the yellow mixture and pause with the lid and spoon still held.
coarse.goal_contribution: Checks and redistributes the stored mixture; ends with the container uncovered rather than demonstrating a finished frozen dessert.
coarse.predictability_reason: After freezing, stirring is a plausible sorbet step but other next actions are possible.
